svg.title: Case 1: The Inflection Point
svg.desc: A lending platform moving billions had mistaken flexibility for zero constraints. I helped plan a Core 1-to-Core 2 rework and build the team to own it—so structured financial data could support reliable insight.
svg.text: Growth was heading toward a breaking point.
A lending platform moved billions while corrupted financial records accumulated.
VC funding kept it running; new releases broke features already in production.
THE GROWTH TRAJECTORY AT THE POINT OF INTERVENTION
Growth was heading toward a breaking point.
The business was moving billions through a financial system that could not support its trajectory.
The business was moving billions through a financial system that could not support its trajectory. VC funding kept it running
while corrupted records accumulated and each new feature release broke functionality already in production. I helped plan the
core migration, restore financial controls, and build the product and tech team to own the system.
Restore financial controls · Migrate the core · Establish team ownership

the core and its ongoing development.
Structured financial data, compliance rules, and team ownership support reliable insight.
Growth trajectories illustrate the intervention and projected risk; they are not measured results.
